Rashi on Shabbat 71a:1:1.hebrew: קצירה גוררת קצירה - שניה בכפרתה, וטחינה גוררת את הטחינה השניה, ונתכפרו כולן. דקיימא לן: אכל שני זיתי חלב בהעלם אחד — אינו חייב אלא אחת; וזה שעשה שתי קצירות בהעלם אחד, שלא נודע לו בין קצירה לקצירה שחטא, ואע"פ שהעלמה של שניה חלוק קצת משל ראשונה — סוף סוף העלם אחד הוא, דלא נודע לו חטאו בינתים, וידיעות [חטא] הוא דמחלקת. הלכך, חטאת זו שבאה על הקצירה וטחינה ראשונה — אתרווייהו קיימא, ונתכפרו עם הקצירה כל קצירות שעליו שנעשו בהעלם אחד, ועם הטחינה נתכפרו כל הטחינות שעליו כשעשאן בהעלם אחד:
Rashi on Shabbat 71a:1:1.english: Reaping draws reaping - [Draws] the second into its atonement; and grinding draws the second grinding, and they are all atoned for. For we maintain: [If one] ate two olive-bulks of forbidden fat in a single lapse of awareness, he is liable for only one [sin-offering]. And this [person] who performed two acts of reaping in a single lapse of awareness — as he did not become aware between one reaping and the other reaping that he had sinned — even though the lapse of awareness of the second is somewhat distinct from that of the first, ultimately it is a single lapse of awareness, since he did not become aware of his sin in the interim, and it is awareness [of sin] that divides [transgressions]. Therefore, this sin-offering that comes for the first reaping and grinding stands for both of them, and along with the reaping are atoned all reapings incumbent upon him that were performed in a single lapse of awareness, and along with the grinding are atoned all grindings incumbent upon him when he performed them in a single lapse of awareness.

Rashi on Shabbat 71a:1:2.hebrew: אבל נודע לו על הקצירה - אחרונה, שבזדון שבת ושגגת מלאכות, והפריש עליה קרבן — הואיל ובקרבן זה לא שייכא טחינה שעמה, דהא אכל חדא מיחייב אי הוה מתידעי ליה תרווייהו:
Rashi on Shabbat 71a:1:2.english: However, he became aware of the reaping - [The] latter [reaping], which was with intentional [desecration of] Shabbat and unwitting [transgression of prohibited] labors, and he set aside an offering for it — since the grinding [performed] with it does not pertain to this offering, for behold, he is liable for each one if both of them had become known to him.

Rashi on Shabbat 71a:1:3.english: Reaping draws reaping - [It draws the] first [reaping].

Rashi on Shabbat 71a:1:4.hebrew: קצירה גוררת קצירה - כמשפט דשני זיתי חלב בהעלם אחד הן. וטחינה שעם קצירה ראשונה — היינו משום גרירה; דאף על גב דעיקר קרבן לאו משום קצירה דבהדה אתא, הואיל ואיכפר ליה בהדי קצירה בתרייתא — גררה לטחינה שעמה בהדה, שהרי שתיהן היו תלויות בקרבן אחד, ואין כפרה לזו בלא זו:
Rashi on Shabbat 71a:1:4.english: Reaping draws reaping - They are [governed] by the law of two olive-bulks of forbidden fat [eaten] in a single lapse of awareness. And [as for] the grinding that was with the first reaping, that is by means of drawing; for even though the primary [obligation of the] offering did not come on account of the reaping that was with it, since it was atoned for along with the latter reaping, it drew along with it the grinding that was with it, for both of them were dependent on a single offering, and there is no atonement for one without the other.

Rashi on Shabbat 71a:1:5.english: And the grinding that is with it - [That] of the first [reaping].

Rashi on Shabbat 71a:1:6.english: And the latter grinding - [That is,] the one corresponding to the first [grinding].

Rashi on Shabbat 71a:1:7.hebrew: במקומה עומדת - וכי מתידע ליה, מיחייב עלה:
Rashi on Shabbat 71a:1:7.english: Remains in its place - And when it becomes known to him, he is liable [to bring an offering] for it.

Rashi on Shabbat 71a:2:1.hebrew: וטחינה שכנגדה עומדת במקומה - דגרירה לגרירה לא אמרינן, לאיכפורי טחינה אחרונה עם טחינה ראשונה משום שני זיתי חלב בהעלם אחד, דהא קמייתא גופה בגרירה היא דמיכפרה:
Rashi on Shabbat 71a:2:1.english: And the corresponding grinding remains in its place - For we do not say [that] drawing [extends] to drawing, to atone for the latter grinding together with the first grinding on account of [the rule of] two olive-bulks of forbidden fat in a single lapse of awareness, for the first [grinding] itself is atoned for [only] through drawing.

Rashi on Shabbat 71a:2:2.hebrew: שם טחינה אחת היא - ואע"ג דקמייתא גופא בגרירה אתיא, אמרינן גרירה לגרירה:
Rashi on Shabbat 71a:2:2.english: The designation of grinding is one - And even though the first [act of grinding] itself comes [to be atoned for] through drawing, we say [there is] drawing upon drawing.

Rashi on Shabbat 71a:2:3.hebrew: ומי אית ליה לרבא גרירה - אטחינה שעמה קפריך, דמגררה עם הקצירה, ואע"ג דקרבן לאו אההיא קצירה איפריש; דאינך כולהו — לאו גרירה איכא, דקצירה וקצירה בהעלם אחד לאו גרירה היא, דכל שם עבירה הנכפל כמה פעמים בהעלם אחד אין בו אלא חטאת אחת:
Rashi on Shabbat 71a:2:3.english: And does Rava hold of drawing? - [The Gemara] raises its objection regarding "the grinding that was with it," that it is drawn along with the reaping even though the sacrifice was not designated for that reaping. For in all the other [aspects], there is no [actual] drawing, as [two acts of] reaping in a single lapse of awareness is not [an instance of] drawing, since any category of transgression that is repeated multiple times in a single lapse of awareness entails only a single sin-offering.

Rashi on Shabbat 71a:2:4.english: The first and second are atoned for - For behold, [the second] was within its [the first's] lapse of awareness.

Rashi on Shabbat 71a:2:5.hebrew: שלישי אין מתכפר - ולא אמרינן: הואיל והשני מתכפר עם הראשון שבהעלמו, ליגרריה לשלישי עמו בכפרתו, ואע"ג דלא שייך בהדי ראשון:
Rashi on Shabbat 71a:2:5.english: The third is not atoned for - And we do not say: Since the second is atoned for along with the first that was in its lapse of awareness, let it drag the third along with it in its atonement, even though [the third] has no connection to the first.

Rashi on Shabbat 71a:3:1.english: If he brought an offering, etc. - For when he designated it, he specified for it the name of that [particular] olive-bulk.

Rashi on Shabbat 71a:3:2.hebrew: הביא קרבן על האמצעי נתכפרו כולם - ואין זה גרירה, אלא כולם בהעלם של זה היו:
Rashi on Shabbat 71a:3:2.english: If he brought a sacrifice for the middle one, all of them attained atonement - And this is not [a case of] drawing, but rather all of them were within the lapse of awareness of this [middle] one.

Rashi on Shabbat 71a:3:3.english: Abaye said, etc. - For he holds [the principle of] drawing.

Rashi on Shabbat 71a:3:4.hebrew: בתר דשמעיה - רבא מאביי, דאמר: "אפילו הביא קרבן על אחד מהם נתכפרו כולם", דאית ליה גרירה — הדר ביה איהו, ואמר לההיא דלעיל, דמיכפרה טחינה שעמה בגרירה:
Rashi on Shabbat 71a:3:4.english: After he heard it - Rava [heard it] from Abaye, who said: "Even if he brought a sacrifice for [any] one of them, all of them are atoned for," since he holds [the principle of] dragging — he [Rava] retracted [his view] and stated that [ruling] above, that the grinding [performed] along with it is atoned for through dragging.

Rashi on Shabbat 71a:3:5.hebrew: אי הכי - דכאביי סבירא ליה, דאמר גרירה:
Rashi on Shabbat 71a:3:5.english: If so - That he holds in accordance with Abaye, who stated [the principle of] drawing:

Rashi on Shabbat 71a:3:6.hebrew: טחינה - שעמה, דאיכפרה בגרירה, תגרור נמי לטחינה שכנגדה, משום שני זיתי חלב בהעלם אחד:
Rashi on Shabbat 71a:3:6.english: Grinding - [The act of grinding] that was with it, which attained atonement through drawing, should also draw the parallel [act of] grinding, on account of [the case of] two olive-bulks of forbidden fat in one lapse of awareness.

Rashi on Shabbat 71a:3:7.hebrew: גרירה דגרירה - כי הך: דטחינה קמייתא לא איכפרה אלא בגרירה — דלא עליה ולא על קצירה שעמה בא הקרבן, אלא דאגריר בהדי קצירה — הלכך, לא הדרה גרירה לבתרייתא משום שם טחינה:
Rashi on Shabbat 71a:3:7.english: Drawing of drawing - Such as this [case]: where the first [act of] grinding received atonement only through drawing — for neither for it nor for the reaping that was with it did the sacrifice come, but rather it was drawn along with [the other] reaping — therefore, [this] drawing does not extend back to the latter [act of grinding] under the category of grinding.

Rashi on Shabbat 71a:4:1.hebrew: מילתא דפשיטא להו - דזדון שבת ושגגת מלאכות וזדון מלאכות ושגגת שבת אין חלוקין לחטאות, כדקאמרי: דזה מתכפר בקרבנו של זה, ולא אמרינן כשני העלמות נינהו וניחייב חד אזדון שבת ושגגת מלאכות וחד אשגגת שבת וזדון מלאכות. ואע"ג דחד גופה דעבירה היא — מספקא ליה, כו':
Rashi on Shabbat 71a:4:1.english: A matter that was obvious to them - That [actions performed with] intentional [awareness of] Shabbat and unwittingness regarding the labors, and intentional [awareness of] the labors and unwittingness regarding Shabbat, are not divided regarding sin-offerings, as they said: that this one attains atonement through the offering of that one, and we do not say that they are like two [separate] lapses of awareness and obligate [him to bring] one [sin-offering] for intentional Shabbat and unwittingness regarding the labors, and one for unwittingness regarding Shabbat and intentional [awareness of] the labors. And even though it is the very same transgression itself, it was uncertain to him [Rabbi Zeira whether they join], etc.:

Rashi on Shabbat 71a:4:2.english: He reaped and ground - [Meaning,] he reaped or ground.

Rashi on Shabbat 71a:4:3.english: He went back and reaped, etc. - And he did not become aware in the interim of his sin.

Rashi on Shabbat 71a:4:4.hebrew: מהו שיצטרפו - קצירה וקצירה לכשיעור ויתחייב — מי הוי העלם אחד ומצטרפי, או דילמא כשני העלמות נינהו ולא מצטרפין:
Rashi on Shabbat 71a:4:4.english: Do they join - [Does] reaping and reaping [join together] to [constitute] the [requisite] measure and he will be liable? Is it [considered] a single lapse of awareness and they join together, or perhaps they are like two lapses of awareness and they do not join together?

Rashi on Shabbat 71a:4:5.hebrew: חלוקין לחטאות - אי הוי כשיעור לכל חד, אין אחד מהן מתכפר בקרבן הבא על חברו. הלכך, לא מצטרפי:
Rashi on Shabbat 71a:4:5.english: [They are] divided with regard to sin-offerings - If there were the [full] measure for each one, neither of them would be atoned for by the sacrifice brought for the other; therefore, they do not combine.

Rashi on Shabbat 71a:5:1.hebrew: הכי גרסינן - וכל היכא דחלוקין לחטאות לא מצטרפי? והא תנן כו':
Rashi on Shabbat 71a:5:1.english: This is our reading - "And wherever they are separate with regard to sin-offerings, do they not join together? But didn't we learn [in a Mishnah]...", etc.

Rashi on Shabbat 71a:5:2.hebrew: חלב וחלב - שני זיתים, והפסיק ביניהם יותר מכדי אכילת פרס, דהוו להו שתי אכילות:
Rashi on Shabbat 71a:5:2.english: Forbidden fat and forbidden fat - Two olive-bulks, and he paused between them for more than the time it takes to eat a half-loaf, so that they constitute two [separate] eatings.

Rashi on Shabbat 71a:5:3.hebrew: שאם אכל חצי זית וחזר ואכל חצי זית - באותו העלם, וכגון שלא שהה מתחילתו של ראשון עד סוף גמר אכילת אחרון יותר מכדי אכילת פרס — ממין אחד מצטרפין:
Rashi on Shabbat 71a:5:3.english: That if one ate half an olive-bulk, and then ate [another] half an olive-bulk - [This applies when it occurred] during the same lapse of awareness; and, for example, where he did not delay from the beginning of the first until the end of completing the eating of the last more than the time it takes to eat a peras — [if they are] of one type, they join together.

Rashi on Shabbat 71a:6:1.hebrew: צריכא למימר - הא חדא אכילה היא, דבשתי אכילות ליכא למאן דאמר חייב:
Rashi on Shabbat 71a:6:1.english: Was it necessary to say: Behold, it is a single eating, for in [the case of] two [separate] eatings, there is no one who says that he is liable.

Rashi on Shabbat 71a:6:2.english: Tutni - The name of a Sage.

Rashi on Shabbat 71a:6:3.hebrew: שני תמחויין - שני מיני תבשיל — אחד צלי ואחד שלוק:
Rashi on Shabbat 71a:6:3.english: Two dishes - Two kinds of cooked food — one roasted and one boiled.

Rashi on Shabbat 71a:6:4.hebrew: ורבי יהושע היא - בכריתות, דאמר תמחויין מחלקין — לאוכל שני זיתים בהעלם אחד בשני תמחויין, לחייבו שתי חטאות. ואיצטריכא לאשמעינן דלענין חצי שיעור מצטרפי, דמהו דתימא: בין לקולא כי הכא, בין לחומרא כגון שיעור שלם, אמר רבי יהושע דחלוקין הן, וגבי שני חצאי שיעור פטור — והיינו קולא, וגבי שני זיתים שלימים חייב שתים — והיינו חומרא:
Rashi on Shabbat 71a:6:4.english: And this is Rabbi Yehoshua - In [Tractate] Keritot, where he said that dishes divide for one who eats two olive-bulks during one lapse of awareness from two dishes, to obligate him [to bring] two sin-offerings. And it was necessary to teach us that with regard to a half-measure they combine; for lest you say: whether as a leniency, as here, or as a stricture, such as [where each has] a full measure, Rabbi Yehoshua said that they are divided, and regarding two half-measures he is exempt — and that is a leniency — and regarding two whole olive-bulks he is liable for two [sin-offerings] — and that is a stricture.

Rashi on Shabbat 71a:7:1.english: Teaches on the first clause - This [statement] of Reish Lakish.

Rashi on Shabbat 71a:7:2.english: We teach it on the latter clause - And it was not stated in that manner.

Tosafot on Shabbat 71a:3:1.hebrew: גרירה דגרירה לית ליה - ומה שגוררת קצירה וטחינה שעמה לא חשיב גרירה דגרירה, כדפי' בקונט': דמה שגוררת קצירה לקצירה לא חשיב גרירה, כיון דהוי בהעלם אחד; אבל טחינה שכנגדה חשיבא גרירה, משום דקצירה של זדון שבת אינה גוררת טחינה של שגגת שבת, אלא על ידי הקצירה שעמה היא נגררת, שעיקר קרבן אינה בשבילה. ולר"י נראה, דקצירה חשיבא גרירה מדקאמר "קצירה גוררת קצירה"; אבל ההיא דטחינה לא חשיבא גרירה דגרירה, שאינו יכול לכפר על הקצירה אא"כ תתכפר הטחינה עמה. ואע"ג דשני זיתי חלב בהעלם אחד לא חשיבא גרירה, מ"מ קצירה וקצירה שאני, שהאחת בשגגת שבת והאחת בזדון שבת; וטעמא דמאן דאמר בסמוך דקצירה וקצירה אין מצטרפין, היינו משום דלית ליה גרירה. וקשה לרשב"א: לפי זה, הוה מצי למצוא פלוגתייהו דאביי ורבא אפילו בשלשה קצירות — כגון שקצר בשגגת שבת וזדון מלאכות, וחזר וקצר בזדון שבת ושגגת מלאכות, ונודע לו הראשונה, וחזר וקצר בשגגת שבת וזדון מלאכות; דלרבא, הביא קרבן על הראשון — שני נתכפר, שלישי לא נתכפר, ולאביי — גם שלישי נתכפר:
Tosafot on Shabbat 71a:3:1.english: He does not hold of drawing of drawing - And [the fact] that reaping draws the grinding that was with it is not considered drawing of drawing, as was explained in the Kunteres: for [the fact] that reaping draws reaping is not considered drawing, since it was in a single lapse of awareness; however, the grinding corresponding to it is considered drawing, because reaping of intentional Shabbat does not draw grinding of unwitting Shabbat except by way of the reaping that was with it is it drawn, as the primary sacrifice is not for its sake. And to the Ri it appears that reaping is considered drawing, since [the Gemara] states: "Reaping draws reaping"; however, that [atonement] of grinding is not considered drawing of drawing, for he cannot achieve atonement for the reaping unless the grinding is atoned along with it. And even though two olive-bulks of forbidden fat in a single lapse of awareness are not considered drawing, nevertheless, reaping and reaping are different, for one was with unwitting Shabbat and the other with intentional Shabbat; and the reasoning of the one who says nearby that reaping and reaping do not combine is that he does not hold of drawing. And the Rashba raises a difficulty: According to this, [the Gemara] could have found the dispute between Abaye and Rava even with three acts of reaping — such as where he reaped with unwitting Shabbat and intentional prohibited labors, and then reaped with intentional Shabbat and unwitting prohibited labors, and became aware of the first, and then reaped [again] with unwitting Shabbat and intentional prohibited labors; for according to Rava, [if] he brought a sacrifice for the first, the second is atoned, [but] the third is not atoned, whereas according to Abaye, even the third is atoned.

Tosafot on Shabbat 71a:6:1.hebrew: ממין אחד חייב פשיטא - הוה מצי לשנויי: הא מני? רבן גמליאל היא, כדאמרינן בסמוך:
Tosafot on Shabbat 71a:6:1.english: "[If he ate] from one type he is liable" — [that is] obvious - [The Gemara] could have answered: Whose [view] is this? It is Rabban Gamliel, as we say nearby.

Tosafot on Shabbat 71a:7:1.hebrew: אנן אסיפא מתנינן לה - אפילו ארישא הוה מצי לשנויי: כגון שאכלו בשני תמחויין, ולאפוקי מרבי יהושע דאמר תמחויין מחלקין אפילו לקולא; אלא דניחא ליה לאוקמי כר' יהושע:
Tosafot on Shabbat 71a:7:1.english: "We taught it with regard to the latter clause" - Even with regard to the first clause, he could have answered: [for instance,] where he ate it from two dishes, and [this ruling comes] to exclude [the opinion of] Rabbi Yehoshua, who said that dishes divide even as a leniency; rather, it was preferable to him to establish [the mishna] in accordance with Rabbi Yehoshua.

Tosafot on Shabbat 71a:7:2.hebrew: משני מינין פשיטא - אף על גב דלענין מלקות מצטרפין, כדאמרינן בפרק בתרא דמס' ע"ז (דף סי.) ובמס' מעילה (דף יז:) — לענין קרבן פשיטא ליה דאין מצטרפין:
Tosafot on Shabbat 71a:7:2.english: "[From] two types, [it is] obvious" - Even though regarding lashes they combine, as we say in the last chapter of Tractate Avodah Zarah (66a) and in Tractate Meilah (17b) — regarding a sacrifice, it is obvious to [the Gemara] that they do not combine.
